title: Crispy Tripe Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring tripe, stir-fried with vegetables and served with a side of crispy fritters.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the tripe and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic, and stir to combine.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the tripe is cooked through.
Stir in the crushed fritters and chopped green onions.
Cook for another minute, until everything is well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
